撼.def: to incite, to move, to shake

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 感 (feel) as the sound: to shake something with the hands.

撼.name: jolt

ety.hint: The rocks 石 that make up a mountain 山

origin.says: 山 (mountain) plus 石 (stone): rocks of a mountain, a cliff. A Han-era variant that replaced 巖 (山 plus 嚴 as the sound).
衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 寸 (inch) as the sound: an under-layer or lining. Simplified from 襯, whose sound part 親 (relative) was replaced by the simpler 寸.

ety.hint: A person 亻 attacked 戈

origin.says: 亻 (person) with 戈 (halberd) across the neck: to strike down a person, to attack; also to cut down trees.

枢.def: door hinge; pivot; center of power

origin.says: 木 (wood) for the meaning plus 区 (district) as the sound: the wooden pivot of a door, then a center of power. Simplified from 樞 by the shorthand 区.

枢.name: hinge

喻.def: metaphor, analogy; example; such as, like

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 俞 (yes; a dugout boat) as the sound: explaining by speech, hence a comparison or metaphor.

喻.name: metaphor

淋.def: to drench, to drip, to soak; perfectly

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 林 (grove) as the sound: water pouring down, to drench.

淋.name: drench

ety.hint: To possess 有 wealth 贝

origin.says: Simplified from 賄: 貝 (cowry, money) for the meaning plus 有 (have) as the sound: wealth, gifts; now a bribe. 貝 is written 贝.
Simplified from 賂: 貝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 各 (each) as the sound: a gift of goods, a bribe. 貝 is written 贝.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 焦 (scorched) as the sound: banana or plantain plants.

驳.def: variegated, motley; to refuse, to dispute

origin.says: 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 爻 (crossed marks) as the sound and a hint of spots: a piebald horse, mixed colours, then to contradict. Simplified from 駁 by writing 馬 as 马.

驳.name: refute

屈.def: to bend, to flex; bent, crooked, crouched

origin.says: Originally 出 (go out) as the sound plus 尾 (tail) for the meaning, a short or bent tail; the tail part was cut down to 尸 in later script. Hence to bend, crouch, wrong someone.

屈.name: bent tail

ety.hint: A feathered 羽 fan in the shape of a folding door 户

origin.says: 户 (door) plus 羽 (feathers): a feather fan that swings like a door leaf; also a door panel.
Water (written 冫 (ice) in the modern form) for the meaning plus 奏 (to play) as the sound: waters coming together, to gather, to piece together. Simplified from 湊 by writing 氵 (water) as 冫.

挠.def: to yield; to scratch, to disturb

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 尧 (lofty) as the sound: to scratch, to disturb, to bend. Simplified from 撓, with 堯 written as 尧.

挠.name: scratch

origin.says: 亨 (go smoothly) as the sound plus 灬 (fire) for the meaning: cooking over a fire.
First just 羊 (sheep, a good sign); 礻 (altar) was added later to set it apart: an omen, good fortune.
Simplified from 廂: a building roof (广, cut to 厂 (cliff)) for the meaning plus 相 (mutual) as the sound: a side room or wing.
Simplified from 豈, whose origin is unclear (perhaps a drum). The bottom 豆 (bean vessel) was replaced by 己 (self) for the sound; the top 山 (mountain) is only a shape. Used for 'how could…?'.

ety.hint: Silk 帛 inlaid with gold 钅; 钅 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 帛 (silk) for the meaning plus 金 (metal, gold) as the sound: richly woven silk, brocade. Simplified from 錦.

闯.def: to rush in, to charge in, to burst in

ety.hint: A horse 马 charging through a gate 门

origin.says: Simplified from 闖: a horse (馬) rushing out through a gate (門): to charge, to burst in. 門 is written 门 and 馬 马.

闯.name: barge in

origin.says: From 遜: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 孫 (grandchild) as the sound: to step back, yield, so humble; also 'inferior'. 孫 became 孙.

缴.def: to deliver, to submit, to hand over

origin.says: 纟 (silk) for the meaning plus 敫 (shining) as the sound: a silk cord tied to an arrow; the modern 'to hand over' is a later sense. Simplified from 繳 with the silk side in shorthand.

缴.name: submit

origin.says: 穴 (cave, hole) for the meaning plus 乍 (suddenly) as the sound: narrow, tight like a small cave.
舟 (boat) for the meaning plus 白 (white) as the sound: a big ocean-going ship.

翘.def: outstanding; to elevate, to lift, to raise

origin.says: 羽 (feathers) for the meaning plus 尧 (lofty) as the sound: long tail feathers sticking up, hence to raise, to tilt up, outstanding. Simplified from 翹.

翘.name: tilt up

origin.says: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 留 (stay) as the sound: a lump that stays in the body, a tumor.

ety.hint: Picture of a tongue with 一 marking the sweet spot

origin.says: A mouth (口) with a short line inside marking something sweet held in it: sweet, tasty, and so willing, content.
Read today as 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 敕 (decree) as the sound: young and tender. One source calls it a warped form of an older character whose origin is unclear.
An old drawing whose subject is disputed: a man bending over, a tree root, a spoon, or a staff marking a clan. Borrowed for clan and family name.
宓 (quiet) as the sound plus 虫 (insect) for the meaning: what insects make, honey; hence sweet.

抚.def: to pat, to console; to stroke, to caress

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 无 (none) as the sound: to stroke with the hand, to soothe. Simplified from 撫 by swapping in 无 for 無.

抚.name: stroke

ety.hint: A furry 毛 tail behind a body 尸

origin.says: 尸 (a body seen from behind) with 毛 (hair) sticking out at the back: a tail, the end.

ety.hint: A person 土 whose cheeks are burning 火

origin.says: 大 (a person) over 火 (fire): the color of fire, red; also bare. The person became 土 and the fire a reshaped bottom.
忄 (heart) for the meaning plus 兑 (exchange) as the sound: pleased, glad; a sense once written 說 (speak).

ety.hint: Bewitching 迷 words 讠; 迷 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 言 (speech) plus 迷 (to be lost, confused), which gives sound and meaning: words that bewilder, a riddle. Simplified from 謎.

滴.def: to drip; a drop of water

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 啇 (root) as the sound: a drop of water, to drip.

滴.name: droplet

勿.def: must not, do not; without, never

ety.hint: A knife 勹 cutting fragments 丿 off

origin.says: A drawing of a knife with drops or cut pieces beside it, first meaning 'to cut'. It was borrowed early for a word meaning 'do not'.

勿.name: do not

ety.hint: A person 卜 (altered form of 人) laying in bed 臣

origin.says: Traditional 臥 is 臣 (lowered eye) plus 人 (person): a person bent down with eyes lowered, resting, to lie down. The simplified form writes the person as 卜 (divine).

盼.def: to look, to gaze; to expect, to hope for

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 分 (divide) as the sound: eyes looking out for something, to gaze, to hope for.

盼.name: long for

origin.says: 衤 (clothing) for the meaning plus 君 (ruler) as the sound: a skirt.

ety.hint: To foresee ⺊ the dawn 早 coming; 早 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Early forms show a person standing tall with something raised above the head; the object is disputed (a flag, an altar). So 'tall, outstanding'. The lower part now looks like 早 (early).
亡 (lose) as the sound plus 民 (people) for the meaning: common people, subjects; later also a rogue.

奠.def: to found, to settle; to pay respects; a libation for the dead

ety.hint: A man 大 lifting up an offering of wine 酋

origin.says: A wine vessel 酉 (wine jar) set on a mat or altar, later with drops above it (酋): a libation, to set down firmly, to found. The altar became 大 (big).

奠.name: libation

origin.says: Simplified from 鯊: 沙 (sand) as the sound plus 鱼 (fish) for the meaning: the shark. Only the fish part was simplified.
日 (sun) for the meaning plus 青 (blue-green) as the sound: a clear, sunny sky.
𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 本 (root) as the sound: first the coarse inner layer of bamboo, later dull, clumsy, stupid.

ety.hint: A hand 攵 leading an ox 牛

origin.says: 牛 (ox) plus 攵 (a hand holding a stick): driving cattle with a switch, to herd.
Simplified from 鯨: 魚 (fish) for the meaning plus 京 (capital, also great, huge) as the sound: the huge fish, the whale. 魚 (fish) is written in its short form 鱼.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 寿 (long life) as the sound: big waves. Simplified from 濤 with 壽 shortened to 寿.

沾.def: to moisten, to soak, to wet; to touch

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 占 (divine) as the sound: to wet, to moisten, and so to touch.

沾.name: moisten

origin.says: 缶 (earthen pot) for the meaning plus 雚 (heron) as the sound: a jar or pot, now also a tin can.

ety.hint: A lofty 乔 carriage 车; 乔 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 轎: 車 (vehicle) for the meaning plus 喬 (tall) as the sound: a carried chair. Both parts are simplified, to 车 and 乔.

塌.def: to collapse, to fall into ruin

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 𦐇 as the sound: earth falling in, to collapse.

塌.name: cave in

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 戋 (small, short form of 戔) as the sound: shallow water, hence shallow or superficial. Simplified from 淺.
Simplified from 鄧: 阝 (city) for the meaning plus 登 (climb) as the sound, a place and then a surname. The simplified form replaced 登 (climb) with 又 (again), used only as a simple stand-in mark.
疒 (illness) for the meaning plus 知 (know) as the sound: a sickness of the mind, foolish. It replaced 癡, whose sound part 疑 (doubt) was swapped for 知.
纟 (thread, rope) for the meaning plus 尃 (spread out) as the sound: to tie up, to bind. Simplified from 縛 (the silk side became 纟).
虫 (insect) for the meaning plus 枼 (leaf) as the sound: the butterfly, thin as a leaf.
虫 (insect) for the meaning plus 胡 (reckless) as the sound: used in the word for butterfly.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 登 (climb) as the sound: water that has settled and become clear.

愧.def: ashamed, regretful; the pangs of conscience

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 鬼 (ghost) as the sound: ashamed. Originally written 媿 with 女 (woman); one old reading takes it as shame + spirit.

愧.name: ashamed

殴.def: to hit, to beat, to fight with fists

origin.says: 殳 (a hand with a weapon, action) for the meaning plus 区 (district) as the sound: to beat, to hit. Simplified from 毆 by the shorthand 区.

殴.name: beat up

origin.says: Once a drawing of a spider; later 虫 (bug) took its place for the meaning and 朱 was added as the sound: spider.

ety.hint: A woman 女 cooking food 日 for a house 宀 banquet

origin.says: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 妟 (at ease: a woman under the sun) as the sound: rest and ease at home, then a feast.

滞.def: to block, to obstruct; sluggish, stagnant

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 带 (belt) as the sound: water held back, stagnant. Simplified from 滯 by using the simplified 带.

滞.name: stagnant water

origin.says: First 暀: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 往 (go) as the sound; now shortened to 日 plus 王 (king) as the sound: bright, flourishing.

ety.hint: A farm 阝 with a well 井; 井 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 繹: 糸 (silk) for the meaning plus 睪 as the sound: to draw out a silk thread; hence to unravel, to interpret. 糸 is written 纟 and 睪 is shortened to 𠬤.
虫 (creature) for the meaning plus 知 (know) as the sound: the spider (as in 蜘蛛, spider).

悼.def: to grieve, to lament, to mourn

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 卓 (tall) as the sound: to mourn, to grieve.

悼.name: grieve

泣.def: to cry, to sob, to weep

origin.says: 氵 (water, tears) for the meaning plus 立 (stand) as the sound: to weep quietly.

泣.name: sob

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 尼 (nun) as the sound: a girl, a maid; common in girls' names.
Simplified from 纖: 糸 (silk, now 纟) for the meaning plus a complex sound part, replaced by 千 (thousand): fine, thin as silk. It also stands for 縴, a towrope.
